details.method: Run static checks for the complete candidate diff against the observed target main, and require the whole-PR CI result for the exact signed head; an identical-tree signature commit can have a passing empty-diff branch run.
details.when: The writer signs a same-tree delivery commit and CI scopes checks by changed files.
details.counterexample: A branch build that explicitly checks the full target diff can be sufficient for that scope; compiler-only and empty signature diffs cannot establish whole-PR static validation.
details.trial_plan: On the corrected four-file candidate run mypy, formatting and include validation across all files changed since main; then compare exact signed-head branch and whole-PR CI. Require both applicable checks to pass, retain original whole-PR failure and verify main readback separately.
